pt.answer: In {name}, {p} of the {n} stops with real-time data were on time so far on {day}; {skip} were cancelled and {late} were at least 5 minutes late.
pt.answerDe: Across {cities} cities with a sharing fleet, {p} of the {n} stops with real-time data were on time so far today.
pt.answerNone: There are no public transport figures for {name} yet; they appear with the collector's next run (about every 20 minutes).
pt.how: Based on the open real-time feed from gtfs.de for all of Germany, which the collector reads about every 20 minutes. A stop counts as late from 5 minutes and as cancelled when the feed reports it so. Only stops with real-time data are counted; trips without real-time data are missing. No passenger counts.
pt.mapSub: Buses and trains where they should be right now according to the last reported stop times and delays. Positions advance every second, and every minute the page asks for a newer report. Estimated, not tracked.
pt.mapStale: The stop times from the run at {time} only reach {min} minutes ahead. New vehicle paths arrive with the collector's next run.
pt.mapNone: No vehicle paths loaded; they arrive with the collector's next run.
pt.mapEmpty: There are no vehicle paths for this city yet. They appear with the collector's next run (about every 20 minutes).
pt.mapNote: The collector delivers a new report about every 20 minutes with the stop times for the next {min} minutes; in between the map keeps calculating from the last one. Between two stations a vehicle moves evenly along the route where it is known, otherwise along the straight line. Hovering shows the destination and next stop, a click lists the next stops with times (delay included); from zoom level 15 the destination is on the label. Trips without real-time data are missing.
pt.dashSub: Stops with real-time data per day: on time, cancelled, at least 5 minutes late. Today is still running.
pt.dayGap: ({n} h without complete real-time data, not counted)
pt.dashNote: An hour counts as disrupted from 20 stops when at least 15 % are cancelled or 30 % are late. The feed reports fully cancelled trips without a time, so they are shown per day only. Hours in which the feed delivers less than a quarter of the usual stops count as a gap and are left out.
pt.dashEmpty: There are no hours for {name} yet. The series starts with the collector's next run.
pt.stSub: {n} of {all} stations with real-time data, summed over {days} days (older days count less, half-life {hl} days). Shown are stations with 40 stops or more.
pt.asSub: Available e-scooters and bikes within 15 m of the stop centre, collector's last fleet
pt.asLead: {n} vehicles stand at {s} stops within 15 m.
pt.asNone: According to the last fleet no sharing vehicle stands within 15 m of a stop in {name}; the next collector run checks again.
pt.asNote: A hint, not a violation: GPS is often 5 to 10 m off, and the distance is measured from the bundled stop (for large stations not the platform). Whether parking is banned there is up to the city.
pt.findNone: No line and no stop “{q}” in the last report.
pt.boardNone: The feed reports no departure at {name} in the next 70 minutes.
pt.boardNote: From the collector's last report (about every 20 minutes), delay included; trips without real-time data are missing.
pt.lineLead: Line {l}: {n} trips in the last report, {s} stations in the municipality, {low} of them with at most one available sharing vehicle within {r} m. If the line fails, there is no replacement there.
pt.lineNoFleet: Sharing fleet not loaded: switch on “Show sharing vehicles”.
pt.stFew: No station has 40 stops in the sum yet. That changes after a few hours of collecting.
pt.stEmpty: No stations have been counted for {name} yet. Counting starts with the collector's next run.
pt.effSub: Sharing trip starts against the previous day's forecast, in disrupted hours compared with the other hours of the same city (6 am to 10 pm).
pt.effPooled: Across all cities: {e} trip starts in disrupted hours (90 % interval {ci}, {n} city-days from {c} cities): {v}.
pt.effPooledNone: A statement across all cities still lacks disrupted days (5 city-days are needed).
pt.effMineNone: {name} had no disrupted hour with a forecast in the window.
pt.effNote: Each day counts as one value because the hours of a day are related. The figure describes an association, not a cause: rain or a major event can move both at once.
pt.effEmpty: No city has had disrupted hours with a forecast in the window yet. The analysis is recalculated with every collector run.
pt.hubTitle: Where a sharing station would make sense
pt.hubSub: Stations with a lot of public transport, frequent disruptions and existing sharing demand within {r} m, but without a parking area. Checked {n} stations with {min} stops per day or more; {has} already have an area.
pt.hubEmpty: No station meets the threshold. Proposals appear with more collected days.
pt.hubNote: Score = 40 % public transport stops, 30 % disruption rate, 30 % trip ends, each compared across this city's stations. Existing area = an operator's parking island within 50 m ({isl} islands from the zone feeds). Trip ends: {abs}. A proposal does not replace a site visit.
pt.hubAbsNo: no count for this city yet
pt.listSub: Stops with real-time data since midnight per city with a sharing fleet. Pick a city to see the map, stations and proposals.
pt.listEmpty: No city counted yet. The list fills with the collector's next run.
pt.source: Sources: {attr}. Derived files under oepnv/ are licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
pt.lnSub: {n} lines with real-time data, summed over {days} days. Shown are lines with 40 stops or more, sorted by the share of cancelled and late stops.
pt.lnNote: Only stops inside the city are counted. Lines with the same name from different operators are merged. A trip's line comes from the gtfs.de timetable; trips without an entry are missing.
pt.lnFew: No line has 40 stops in the sum yet. That changes after a few hours of collecting.
pt.lnEmpty: No lines have been counted for this city yet. Counting starts with the collector's next run.
pt.pfTitle: When public transport barely runs and sharing does
pt.pfSub: Hourly mean over {days} days: bus and train stops with real-time data against sharing trip starts.
pt.pfGap: In {name}, public transport runs below {share} of its daily peak {spans}. In these hours, {n} sharing trips start per day on average, which is {p} of all trips.
pt.pfNoGap: In {name} there is no hour in which public transport falls below {share} of its daily peak while at least {min} sharing trips start.
pt.pfNote: Gap means: public transport below {share} of the peak and at least {min} sharing trip starts in the hour. Stops without real-time data are missing, so in cities with little real-time data public transport looks thinner than it is.
pt.pfEmpty: {name} still lacks full days with public transport stops and sharing trips. The daily profile appears from tomorrow.
pt.mapStatus2: {n} vehicles running, {late} of them at least 5 minutes late. Last report at {time}, {age} minutes ago. {share}
pt.nowTitle: Disrupted now: where sharing may be in demand
pt.nowSub: Stations with many cancellations or delays in the last {h} hours and the available sharing vehicles within 300 m.
pt.nowLead: In {name}, {n} stations were disrupted in the last {h} hours.
pt.nowLeadVeh: {none} of them have no sharing vehicle within 300 m, and {few} more have two at most.
pt.nowLeadNoFleet: This city's sharing fleet is not loaded, so the number of vehicles nearby is missing.
pt.nowEffMore: In {name}, {e} more sharing trips start in disrupted hours than usual so far.
pt.nowEffLess: In {name}, {e} fewer sharing trips start in disrupted hours than usual so far.
pt.nowEffOpen: Whether disruptions in {name} raise sharing demand cannot be distinguished from the days so far; the list shows where it is worth looking.
pt.nowNote: Disrupted means: with {min} or more stops with real-time data, at least 30 % cancelled or late, or 15 % cancelled. Sorted by missing vehicles, then by disrupted stops. Based on the collector's last run and the last fleet snapshot. A hint, not a trip forecast.
pt.nowCalm: No station in {name} was disrupted in the last {h} hours. The list is recalculated with every collector run.
pt.lmTitle: Last mile: far from public transport and without sharing
pt.lmSub: Residents living more than {stop} m from any stop with at least {dep} departures a day, and whether an available sharing vehicle stands within {veh} m between 7 am and 10 pm.
pt.lmLead: In {name}, {far} residents ({p}) live more than {stop} m from a stop. {served} of them have a sharing vehicle within {veh} m during the day on average, {gap} have none.
pt.lmNote: Residents from the 2022 census on a 100 m grid, stops from the gtfs.de timetable (straight-line distance, departures on the reference day). The share with a vehicle is the mean over {runs} runs of the current day. Sorted by residents with neither. Operators without an open feed are missing, so more vehicles stand there than the figure shows.
pt.lmEmpty: {name} lacks stops from the timetable or runs between 7 am and 10 pm. The value appears with the next change of hour during the day.
pt.effLearn: Learned (for the forecast, passive since {since}): per city the mean of its disrupted days, pulled towards the effect across all cities with {k} days ({e} from {days} city-days); {n} cities. The forecast shows the disruption correction and only includes it once it proves itself in the comparison (no earlier than {until}).
pt.nowFc: Forecast for this disruption: {p} sharing trips in {name} over the next {h} hours (about {ex} trip starts).
pt.nowFcProbe: Trial: not yet included in forecast and dispatch, released automatically once it proves accurate in the comparison (scored: {n} of at least {min} days).
pt.nowFcLearn: Trial: not yet included, learning period until {until}, then released after comparison.
pt.nowFcOn: Included in forecast and dispatch (released since {d}).
pt.cancelNone: According to real-time data, no trip is cancelled entirely right now.
pt.cancelSum: Cancelled entirely according to real-time data: {n} trips ({list}). {w} of them fall between half an hour ago and {min} minutes ahead and are drawn dashed; for {nt} the feed gives no time, so they are missing from the map.
pt.cancelSumNoTime: Cancelled entirely according to real-time data: {n} trips ({list}). The feed gives no time for {nt} of them, so they are not on the map.
pt.pathsAir: The map draws line paths only along the actual route: trains and trams on their tracks, buses on the roads they may use. There are no route shapes for {name} yet (the monthly geo run calculates them for the cities with the largest fleets); until then it shows only vehicles and stations.
pt.pathsGeo: Line paths follow the route from OpenStreetMap: trains and trams on their tracks, buses on the roads they may use (main roads and bus lanes before residential streets).
pt.pathsShare: Line paths: {p} % of {n} sections follow the route from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), trains on tracks, buses on roads with one-way rules.
pt.vehStops: Next stops according to real-time data:
pt.pathsHidden: {n} sections without a known route are not drawn; vehicles still move there.
